assignment.hypothesis: Blood: on b2 k4 the tank's Dancing Rune Weapon copies hit at ~6% of its own hits because the Rune Weapon guardian never received its native scaling auras (51906 owner weapon damage + haste - 50%, 61697 hit, 110474 crit); applying them at summon restores the Blizzlike 50% copies (+1.0-1.3k). Glyph of Death Strike (59336) is a dummy aura with no handler; implementing +2%/5 RP up to 40% restores its native effect (+0.5-0.9k). Together with the setup-parity base f52d106673 (Blood glyph set +2.0k, Fallen Crusader +0.6-0.9k) the tank projects to ~25k against 24,844. Balance: 45.5-47.6k in clean stretches, 38.7k overall because parasite windows cost 4.7-7.1k: the policy switched to a threatening parasite without line of sight (8-11 failed casts per kill, 5 s spell blocks, walking toward it), mushroom sets fired on 1-2 parasites (4 GCDs for 24k), and Moonfire recast over a live Sunfire; gating the switch on the native LOS opportunity set (+0.8-1.4k), requiring 3 parasite hits within the native 6 yd radius (+0.6-0.9k) and forbidding Moonfire over Sunfire (+0.2-0.4k) project ~40.9k. Elemental: the b2 drop is proc RNG (non-proc DPS flat); the LOS gate removes its parasite LOS failures too; re-measure.
forbidden_changes: No invented auras, procs, multipliers, forced casts or resource refills; the Rune Weapon receives only its native scaling auras and the glyph only its client-data values.
No change to the shared area-damage protection, encounter scripts, route manifests, the roster beyond the setup-parity base, WCL references, coefficients, the scoreboard or graph tooling.
Parasites stay controlled: a hittable threatening parasite is targeted exactly as before; the mushroom wave-ending rule keeps placed sets from being wasted.
acceptance_conditions: Declared tests pass; module_size reports no oversized file; an independent reviewer (separate subagent session, transcript-bound import-json) approves the exact diff.

A clean policy-bound build, one smoke kill (shared_runtime), then a 5-kill scoreboard batch vs baseline b2-fd4ba456 judged with `scoreboard show --actor <id>` per targeted actor under the playbook keep rule; mechanism evidence: DRW copy hits ~50% of owner hits; Death Strike average hit rising with runic power; glyph auras 58616/58669/63330 present at pull; weapon enchant 3368 in the readback; no LOS-failed casts at parasites for 30001/30010; no 1-2-hit detonations; no Moonfire while Sunfire is up.
